subsystem.name: MathAndCollision
subsystem.responsibility: Vector and matrix math utilities (vector3 add/subtract, 3x3 matrix-vector multiply, dot product, SSE/3DNow matrix builders), particle-system orientation-axis update, and a broad set of bounded/strided array helpers (counted dword arrays, sorted LRU arrays, socket arrays, Bink frame-lookup arrays, particle element arrays, network record arrays, allocation descriptors) plus their teardown, lookup, and reset paths. Most owners are UNKNOWN at the function-IR level; the only named owner is the respawn-state array (VehicleRespawnState).

summary: Proposal for the math_and_collision slice of Wave 5. The functions fall into three groups. (1) Pure math utilities: vector3 add/subtract (0x4EA930, 0x4ED710), 3x3 matrix-vector multiply (0x4ED7B0), vector3 dot product (0x4EFEE0), an SSE constant matrix init (0x52087E) and a 3DNow translation-matrix constructor (0x52273B). (2) A particle-system orientation-axis updater (0x4CC840) that walks a 10-float strided axis array, a vector-field presence test (0x4CE8F0), and a scene-relative direction-vector computation feeding a DirectX vertex buffer (0x55D5C0, 0x55D460). (3) Array containers and their operations: teardown loops (0x4DD470, 0x4DED20), a sorted LRU array with eviction and reporting (0x4DEDB0, 0x4DF030), lazy-init entry cleanup (0x4E0E20), respawn-state array reset (0x4E3890), bounded index reads and lookups (0x54E240, 0x5504D0, 0x558CB0, 0x55BFD0, 0x55BFF0), batch walkers (0x53C190, 0x54C270), a socket array create/search pair sharing a count-at-0x6C base-at-0x8 layout (0x562D20, 0x563230), an int-array allocator (0x560B60), a five-dword allocation descriptor (0x5646D0), and a network record array with linear-interpolation addressing and shift-removal (0x5648B0, 0x564990). Almost every owner is UNKNOWN; the groupings below are DERIVED/GUESS proposals, not confirmed identities.

function_roles.role: Recalculates a strided array of particle orientation axes: obtains a source direction (and a Y component) from an object reached through VirtualDispatchHelper(&dword_5EA510) at offset +36, scales X and Z by -0.03125, walks 10-float entries from unk_8AC840 to the end marker flt_8ACAC0, writes each entry's direction, computes the cross product of the two direction rows, stores it as the entry axis, and normalizes the axis to length this[4]/2 (default X-axis of that length when magnitude is zero).

Pure presence check over three float channels of the input struct: returns TRUE when the float at offset 0x00 is non-zero OR the float at offset 0x14 is non-zero OR the float at offset 0x28 is non-zero; otherwise FALSE. No side effects; frame-path helper called by 0x004EE2D0.

Cleanup helper: frees a single resource pointer at offset 8 via FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null, then when the array pointer at offset 16 is non-null reads the element count from the length header 4 bytes before the array pointer, iterates backward over 24-byte elements calling ShortComputation_d4d0 on each, and frees the allocation (starting at the length header) via FreeWrapper_7bcf; returns the single-free result when no array is present.

Destructor for an object holding two heap arrays whose element counts live in the allocation header 4 bytes before each block: zeroes head fields at offsets 0x4/0x8, tears down the first array (pointer at 0xC, 12-byte elements, per-element teardown sub_4DD4C0) from last to first, frees the block via FreeWrapper_7bcf, zeroes 0xC/0x10, tears down the second array (pointer at 0x14, 24-byte elements, per-element ShortComputation_d4d0), frees it, zeroes 0x14/0x18, and returns 0.

Inserts a 9-float (36-byte) entry into a fixed-capacity sorted array (max 20 entries, stride 9 floats, count at this+0x18, entries from this+0x20): rejects exact duplicates with a -1 index report via sub_4DF110, evicts a minimum-score LRU candidate when full by shifting entries left, finds the sorted insertion position by key a2[1], shifts entries right to make room, copies the entry, increments the count, and returns the sub_4DF110 report of the inserted key and index.

Builds a 9-float stack entry (type marker 1 in slot 0, value a2 in slot 1, slots 2-8 zeroed) and inserts it into the sorted LRU array via SortedArrayInsertWithLRUEviction only when the dword flag at this+0x18 is nonzero; returns the flag value when the insertion is skipped, else the insertion result.

Per-entry lazy-cleanup within an array owned by a subsystem object: selects an array entry by scaling the a2 index by 74 dwords, runs one-time lazy initialization (0x4E0D00) on a sub-block 81 dwords into the entry, advances 98 dwords, runs lazy initialization on the second sub-block, then if that sub-block's first dword is nonzero flags a state condition through FlagFieldBitManipulation(1, 1, 0, 0); otherwise returns the initialization result.

Resets an array of per-vehicle respawn state entries: reads the entry count at this+0xBA8, and when it is greater than zero iterates entries with a 187-float (748-byte) stride starting at this+747 floats, calling sub_4DF110(current_entry, 0.0, -1) on each and clearing the entry's sixth float at this+0xBC4 to 0.0; returns the last-read count. Called by VehicleRespawnReset (0x004E0800).

Per-component 3-float vector subtraction: writes a3[0..2] = a1[0..2] - a2[0..2] and returns the output pointer a3. Invoked from 3D collision, vehicle contact force and vehicle geometry proximity paths.
Per-component 3-float vector addition: writes a3[0..2] = a1[0..2] + a2[0..2] and returns the output pointer a3. Invoked from vehicle geometry proximity and ray/triangle intersection paths.

Multiplies a 3x3 matrix (nine floats at offsets 0x0..0x20) by a three-component vector a2 and stores the result in a3; each output component is the dot of one matrix row with a2. Returns the original input vector pointer a2. Used for rigid-body transforms; called by VehicleGeometryProximityTest (0x004ED420) and RayTriangleIntersectionWithBarycentricCoordinate (0x004EFBD0).

__fastcall 3-component dot product over two float vectors a1 and a2: returns a1[0]*a2[0] + a1[1]*a2[1] + a1[2]*a2[2] as double. No branches, globals or callees. Single static caller: RayTriangleIntersectionWithBarycentricCoordinate (0x004EFBD0).

Initializes a 52-byte matrix/struct at a1 from SSE constants and the __m128 result of EmptyStub_8bd0: row 0 is the fixed constant xmmword_8D61D0, the low dword of xmmword_8D61C0 lands at +0x10 and +0x2C, the full vector at +0x30, and partial stores from the EmptyStub result plus an XOR of its shuffled value with xmmword_8D61B0 fill +0x14/+0x1C/+0x24. Returns a1.

Builds a 4x4 transformation matrix stored as 8 __m64 slots in a1: enters 3DNow mode, seeds identity-like constants (1.0f at this+0x0 and this+0x28, packed 1.0f pair at this+0x10), packs the three float parameters a2, a3, a4 into the last two rows (this+0x30 = punpckldq(a2, a3), this+0x38 = punpckldq(a4, 1.0f)), exits 3DNow mode and returns a1.

Zero-initializes a per-object buffer at this+4 whose element count depends on global dword_8B0108: 576 elements by default, 1152 when the flag is clear; memset clears 4 * v2 bytes (4-byte cells). Returns 0 unconditionally. Called from CMpegBase_Open (0x0052E090) and CMpegFilePlayer_Open (0x0052E1D0), i.e. MPEG open paths.
Fixed-count batch walk over 42 contiguous elements starting at dword_8B6C28 with a 76-byte stride, calling sub_556220 on each element; returns the result of the last call.

Walks a linked list of UI nodes (head at this[129], next pointer at node+0x10); for each node iterates its state-word array (count at node+0x118, base at node+0x11C) and sign-extends each state word by replicating the signed upper 16 bits into the low 16 bits. Called by RecursiveTraversal (0x0054BCD0) as part of UI scene-node state normalization.

Fixed-count batch initialization of a 256-element array of 104-byte float-bearing structs at unk_8B8F40 (stride 26 dwords), calling F_10FloatStructInitializer (0x0053B130) on each element; returns the last initializer result.

Bounds-checked indexed read: when a2 is below the element count at this+0x120, computes an element entry address from the base pointer at this+0x124 with stride 36 (36*a2+8), dereferences it to a target pointer, and returns the DWORD at target+4; returns 0 when a2 is out of range.

Bounds-checked lookup into a frame array: index a3 validated against the count at this+0xA4; entry base is this+0xA8 + 148*a3. For terminal frames (entry field 18 <= 1), optionally resets the Bink video decoder via BinkVideoFrameDecoder when entry field 36 and global dword_8B6AC4 are both non-zero, clearing bit 0x400 on the decoder buffer, then returns the frame pointer at entry field 35. For non-terminal frames, a2 == -1 returns the frame pointer directly; otherwise a sub-indexed lookup against the list at entry field 19 (offset by entry field 20) yields a frame offset of 96 times the selected list entry.

Bounds-checked array element flag setter: when index a2 is below the element count at this[0x2C], calls sub_53B330 on the element entry at array base + a2*128 + 16 with three caller arguments, then sets flag 0x4000 on the element base dword at array base + a2*128; returns the element base pointer on success, or the raw index a2 when out of bounds. Per-frame path called by ParticleCollisionSpark (0x004CB620), WheelRenderObjectPerFrameUpdate (0x004CB860), ParticleTrailEmitter (0x004CBC50) and ParticleInstanceUpdate (0x004CC1D0).

Bounded array accessor: returns element a2 of a dword array that follows a count field; when a2 is >= the count at this+0x4 the accessor fails closed and returns 0, otherwise returns the dword at this + 8 + 4*a2. Used by UtilityFunction_9160 (0x004F9160) and sub_55F0D0 (0x0055F0D0).

Slot-indexed conditional delegator: loads the element pointer at this dword index a2+2, returns -1 when null, forwards a3..a7 to sub_55BD20, returns -1 when that sub-call fails, otherwise stores the slot index a2 back into this[0] and returns the sub-call result.

Stores a 3-component vector (a2, a3, a4) at this+0x44/+0x48/+0x4C, normalizes all three to unit length when the vector length is non-zero, then calls DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup with global dword_8B78A0, this and its handle at this+0x4 under mode 5, and finally ORs dirty flag 0x800 into dword_8B8F28+236; returns dword_8B8F28. Invoked by sub_55A500 on a DirectX vertex-buffer normal/vector update path.

Computes and stores a normalized direction vector on a scene-node object: sets dirty flag 0x40000 at this+0x14, walks a context node list rooted at dword_8B8F28 to find a target entry, obtains a scene position (the object's stored position at this+0xE8..0xF0 or SceneNodePositionGetter result depending on the bit-0x10 flag at the node reached through this+0x138 at byte +0x3C), combines it with the caller offset a2[9..11], and stores a twice-normalized delta direction at this+0x100/0x104/0x108.

Initializes an integer-array container object: zeroes the element-count word at this+0x0, allocates backing storage for a2 integers via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(4 * a2), stores the pointer at this+0x4, and returns this as the initialized container.

Creates a pre-allocated array of sockets: guarded by the count at this+0x6C (returns 0 when not > 0); loops over 28-byte entries off the array base pointer at this+0x8 calling socket(2, 2, 17) and storing the handle at entry+0 with entry+4 and entry+8 zeroed; on a socket() == -1 break returns 1 when no sockets were created, otherwise truncates this+0x6C to the created count and returns 0; returns 0 when the full count is reached. Called by DeviceInitializationWithStateSetup (0x00562C90), MultiStageInitializationChainWithErrorChecking (0x00563020) and NetworkConnection (0x00563260).

Searches a container's array of 7-dword-stride elements for an ID value equal to a2 and returns the zero-based element index, or -1 when no element matches; the element count is read from the container at offset 108 (0x6C) and the array base pointer at offset 8 (elements examined starting 4 bytes into that array). Called by NetworkConnection.

Allocates a five-dword descriptor and a backing array of a2 element slots, then fills every slot with a distinct heap object built by Malloc0x18ByteStructWithInnerBuffer(a6): descriptor index 0 holds the element array pointer, index 1 the element count a2, index 2 the factory parameter a6, indices 3 and 4 the caller-supplied values a4 and a5. Returns the descriptor pointer. Shared by MemoryObjectAllocator (0x00562B50), DirectDrawDisplayModeInit (0x00563E00) and StructAllocInitWithSwitchBasedType (0x005642F0).

Straight-line arithmetic helper matching the ABI label Linear_Interpolation: reads a 32-bit value at object offset +20 as a base and one at offset +8 as a delta, returns base + a2 * delta (a2 acts as the interpolation factor). No branches, calls or side effects.

Removes the element at index a2 from a packed record array rooted at a1: when a2 is not the final element it shifts the array tail down one record by copying a1[2] * (count - a2 - 1) bytes from element a2 + 1 onto element a2 via sub_58B130 (element addresses resolved through LinearInterpolation), then decrements the stored count at a1[0] and returns the new count. The single caller NetworkConnection suggests a connection/record list that shrinks when an entry is dropped.

classes.name: Vector3
classes.responsibility: Three-component float vector container used by the arithmetic helpers: per-component add (0x4ED710) and subtract (0x4EA930) write a caller output pointer from two input vectors. The this-relative reads at 0x0/0x4/0x8 record the first input vector's components.

classes.name: Matrix33VectorMultiplyHelper
classes.responsibility: Row-major 3x3 float matrix (nine floats at 0x0..0x20) multiplied by a three-component vector; used as a rigid-body transform primitive by vehicle-geometry proximity and ray/triangle intersection paths.

classes.name: Vector3DotProductHelper
classes.responsibility: 3-component float dot product returning a double; single consumer is the ray/triangle intersection query (0x004EFBD0). Structural twin of the 0045eb00 cluster whose packet name (Vector3ScalarMultiply) is not confirmed by this packet.

classes.name: ParticleMatrixRotationUpdater
classes.responsibility: Particle-system orientation-axis updater: reads a source direction through a virtual dispatch and rewrites a strided (10-float) array of particle axis rows between unk_8AC840 and the end marker flt_8ACAC0, normalizing each axis to a target half-length stored at this+0x10.

classes.name: VectorFieldPresenceStruct
classes.responsibility: Struct with three float channels at 0x0/0x14/0x28 whose non-zero presence is tested as a frame-path helper; the channel semantics (velocity/magnitude) are not evidenced by the raw source.

classes.name: SingleResourceArrayOwner
classes.responsibility: Object holding one scalar resource pointer at offset 8 and one heap array pointer at offset 16; teardown frees the resource and runs per-element destructors (24-byte elements) before freeing the array allocation at its count-header base.

classes.name: DualArrayOwner
classes.responsibility: Object holding two heap arrays (12-byte and 24-byte elements) whose counts live in each allocation's header; the destructor clears head fields 0x4/0x8, tears each array down element-by-element, frees each block at its header base, and zeroes the pointer/companion pairs 0xC/0x10 and 0x14/0x18.

classes.name: SortedLRUArray
classes.responsibility: Fixed-capacity (20-entry) sorted array of 36-byte records ordered by key at entry[1], with duplicate rejection, minimum-score LRU eviction (scored against globals flt_59E670/flt_5AD140), right-shift insertion, and a reporting callback (0x4DF110). The typed insert (0x4DF030) gates insertion on the flag at this+0x18 and stamps entry slot 0 with a type marker.

classes.name: ArrayEntryLazyInitSubsystem
classes.responsibility: Array of entries (74-dword stride) whose per-entry lazy initialization runs on two sub-blocks (81 and 98 dwords into the entry) via a lazy-init callback (0x4E0D00), with a flag-state path through FlagFieldBitManipulation (0x54C030) when the second sub-block is non-empty. Layout is grounded only in raw addressing.

classes.name: VehicleRespawnState
classes.responsibility: Per-vehicle respawn state array: entry count at this+0xBA8, entries at a 748-byte stride starting at this+747 floats, per-entry state reset through sub_4DF110(entry, 0.0, -1) plus clearing the entry sixth float at this+0xBC4. Reset invoked by VehicleRespawnReset (0x004E0800).

classes.name: SSE52ByteMatrixInitializer
classes.responsibility: Initializes a 52-byte matrix/struct from SSE constants (xmmword_8D61D0/8D61C0/8D61B0) and the __m128 result of EmptyStub_8bd0; stores row 0 at +0, low dwords at +0x10/+0x2C, partial SSE results at +0x14/+0x1C/+0x24, and the full vector at +0x30. The output class is not identified.

classes.name: ThreeDNowTransformBuilder
classes.responsibility: Builds a 4x4 transformation matrix as 8 __m64 slots using 3DNow instructions: identity-like seed constants in slots 0..5, the translation pair (a2, a3) packed at +0x30, and (a4, 1.0f) at +0x38 forming the translation-plus-homogeneous row.

classes.name: ConditionalSizedBufferZeroer
classes.responsibility: Zero-initializes a per-object buffer at this+4 whose element count is 576 by default or 1152 when global dword_8B0108 is clear (4-byte cells); used on MPEG open paths (CMpegBase_Open 0x0052E090, CMpegFilePlayer_Open 0x0052E1D0).

classes.name: IterateStructArray42Helper
classes.responsibility: Fixed-count batch walk over a 42-element global array at dword_8B6C28 with a 76-byte stride, invoking a per-element action (0x00556220); the element type and action semantics are outside this packet.

classes.name: UiSceneStateWordNormalizer
classes.responsibility: Walks a UI element linked list (head at this+0x204, next at node+0x10) and sign-extends each node's state words (count at node+0x118, array at node+0x11C) by replicating the signed upper 16 bits into the low 16 bits. Called by RecursiveTraversal (0x0054BCD0).

classes.name: FloatStructArray256Initializer
classes.responsibility: Fixed-count batch initialization of a 256-element array of 104-byte float-bearing structs at unk_8B8F40, invoking a per-element initializer (0x0053B130); element layout is outside this packet.

classes.name: IndexedElementArray
classes.responsibility: Array container with element count at this+0x120 and base pointer at this+0x124; elements are packed structs of stride 36 whose entry at offset 8 holds a target pointer, and the accessor returns the DWORD at target+4.

classes.name: BinkFrameLookupArray
classes.responsibility: Frame array with count at this+0xA4 and base at this+0xA8; entries are 148-byte structs whose terminal/sub-index layout drives Bink video-frame selection and an optional decoder reset (0x00551DD0) gated by entry field 36 and global dword_8B6AC4.

classes.name: ParticleElementArray
classes.responsibility: Particle element array with count at this[0x2C] and base pointer at this[0x34]; 128-byte elements, per-frame element update through sub_53B330 at entry+16 and a 0x4000 dirty flag on the element base dword. Called per frame by particle collision/spark, wheel-render, trail-emitter and instance-update paths.

classes.name: CountedDwordArray
classes.responsibility: Simple dword array that begins right after a count field: the count at this+0x4 bounds the index and the element at index a2 lives at this + 8 + 4*a2; out-of-range access fails closed with 0.

classes.name: SlotArrayDelegator
classes.responsibility: Slot-indexed delegator over an element-pointer array starting at this dword index 2: loads the element for index a2, returns -1 when the slot is null or the delegated call (0x0055BD20) fails, otherwise records the slot index at this[0] and returns the delegated result.

classes.name: DxVertexBufferVectorStore
classes.responsibility: Stores and unit-normalizes a 3-component vector at this+0x44/0x48/0x4C, pushes it into a DirectX vertex buffer via DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup (0x005416A0, mode 5) using the handle at this+0x4 and global dword_8B78A0, and flags buffer dirtiness at dword_8B8F28+236.

classes.name: SceneRelativeDirectionComputer
classes.responsibility: Scene-node object computing a normalized direction vector: sets dirty flag 0x40000 at this+0x14, walks a context node list rooted at dword_8B8F28, picks a scene position (stored at this+0xE8..0xF0 or via SceneNodePositionGetter 0x0054B950 depending on the node flag at *(this+0x138)+0x3C bit 0x10), and stores a twice-normalized delta direction at this+0x100/0x104/0x108.

classes.name: IntArrayContainer
classes.responsibility: Integer-array container with an element-count word at this+0x0 and a backing allocation at this+0x4; construction zeroes the count and allocates 4*a2 bytes for a2 ints.

classes.name: SocketArrayContainer
classes.responsibility: Array of socket records with count at this+0x6C and base pointer at this+0x8; entries are 28 bytes (7 dwords) with the socket handle/ID at entry+0. Creation (0x562D20) calls socket(2, 2, 17) per entry and zeroes entry+4/+8; search (0x563230) scans entries by their first-dword ID. Both are exercised on NetworkConnection paths.

classes.name: ArrayDescriptorFactory
classes.responsibility: Allocates a five-dword descriptor plus a backing array of a2 element slots, each filled with a distinct heap object built by Malloc0x18ByteStructWithInnerBuffer(a6): descriptor holds {element_array, count, factory_param, caller_value_a, caller_value_b}. Shared allocation contract for three caller paths.

classes.name: NetworkRecordArray
classes.responsibility: Packed record array over network connections: count at offset 0, per-record byte stride at offset 8, element base at offset 14 (20). LinearInterpolation (0x5648B0) resolves element addresses as base + index * stride, and removal (0x564990) shifts the tail down over the removed slot via sub_58B130 and decrements the count. Caller NetworkConnection (0x00563260) is the primary consumer.

transitions.condition: count at this+0x6C <= 0: creation skipped, returns 0
requested count > 0: creation loop enters; on socket() == -1 break with v2 > 0, truncate this+0x6C to v2 and return 0
socket() == -1 on the first attempt (v2 == 0): return 1
loop completes with v2 == requested count: return 0
entry field 18 <= 1: optional Bink decoder reset (entry field 36 and dword_8B6AC4 non-zero), return frame pointer at entry field 35
a2 == -1: return the entry field 35 frame pointer directly
a2 != -1: select entry field 19[abs(a2)] (offset by field 20) and add 96 * selected value to the frame pointer

interfaces.name: IVector3Arithmetic
interfaces.purpose: Contract for the three-component float vector operations: per-component add (0x4ED710) and subtract (0x4EA930) each take two input vectors and a caller output pointer, writing a3[i] = a1[i] +/- a2[i] and returning the output pointer.

interfaces.name: ISortedLRUArray
interfaces.purpose: Contract for the fixed-capacity sorted LRU array: a 36-byte entry with key at entry[1], count at this+0x18, entries from this+0x20, duplicate rejection reporting -1 through sub_4DF110, minimum-score LRU eviction (globals flt_59E670/flt_5AD140), and typed insertion gated by the flag at this+0x18.

interfaces.name: ISocketArrayContainer
interfaces.purpose: Contract for the socket record array shared by NetworkConnection paths: count at this+0x6C, base at this+0x8, 28-byte entries with the socket handle/ID at entry+0. Creation (0x562D20) opens UDP sockets and truncates the count on partial failure; search (0x563230) returns the zero-based index of the first entry whose ID matches.

interfaces.name: IRecordArrayContainer
interfaces.purpose: Contract for the packed network record array: element addresses resolve as base(offset 20) + index * stride(offset 8) through LinearInterpolation, count at offset 0; removal shifts the tail down over the removed slot with a byte block move and decrements the count.

compatibility_contracts.name: ParticleAxisStridedArrayContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The particle orientation updater (0x004CC840) walks a strided array of 10-float entries between unk_8AC840 and the end marker flt_8ACAC0; each entry receives a direction vector and a cross-product axis normalized to length this[4] * 0.5. A replacement must preserve the 10-float stride, the -0.03125 X/Z scaling of the source direction, and the this+0x10 half-length field.

compatibility_contracts.name: VectorFieldChannelPresenceContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The vector-field presence helper (0x004CE8F0) returns TRUE iff any of the three float channels at offsets 0x00, 0x14, 0x28 is non-zero; a replacement must preserve the three dword float offsets and the logical OR of the three non-zero tests.

compatibility_contracts.name: DualArrayTeardownContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The dual-array destructor (0x004DED20) zeroes head fields 0x4/0x8, tears down the 12-byte-element array at 0xC (per-element 0x4DD4C0) and the 24-byte-element array at 0x14 (per-element 0x4DD4D0), frees both allocations at their count-header bases through 0x587BCF, and zeroes the pointer/companion pairs 0xC/0x10 and 0x14/0x18. The count-header (block-4) convention must be preserved.

compatibility_contracts.name: SortedLRUArrayContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The sorted LRU array holds count at this+0x18, a maximum of 20 entries of 36 bytes starting at this+0x20, ordered by the float key at entry[1]. Duplicate entries are rejected with a -1 report through sub_4DF110; full arrays evict a minimum-score candidate (scored against flt_59E670/flt_5AD140) by left shift. A replacement must preserve the entry stride, key slot, duplicate rejection and the 0x18 count field.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleRespawnStateEntryLayoutContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Vehicle respawn state keeps entry count at this+0xBA8 and 748-byte-stride entries starting at this+747 floats; reset (0x004E3890) calls sub_4DF110(entry, 0.0, -1) per entry and clears the entry sixth float at this+0xBC4. A replacement must keep the count field, the 748-byte stride and the reset call shape.

compatibility_contracts.name: BinkFrameLookupContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The frame lookup (0x005504D0) uses count at this+0xA4 and base at this+0xA8 with 148-byte entries: entry field 18 <= 1 marks a terminal frame, entry field 35 holds the frame pointer, field 36 gates the Bink decoder reset (0x00551DD0 with arguments (0, 0, 32) and a 0x400 bit clear) together with global dword_8B6AC4, and non-terminal sub-indexing scales the entry-field-19 list value by 96. a2 == -1 selects the base frame pointer.

compatibility_contracts.name: ParticleElementArrayContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The particle element array (0x00558CB0) keeps count at this[0x2C] and base at this[0x34] with 128-byte elements; the per-frame update calls sub_53B330 at element base + 16 and sets flag 0x4000 on the element base dword. A replacement must preserve the stride, the two header offsets and the 0x4000 flag semantics.

compatibility_contracts.name: SocketArrayLayoutContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The socket array (0x00562D20, 0x00563230) keeps count at this+0x6C and base at this+0x8 with 28-byte entries whose first dword is the socket handle/ID; creation calls socket(2, 2, 17), zeroes entry+4/+8, and truncates the count on partial failure; search returns the index of the matching first dword or -1. Caller NetworkConnection depends on this layout.

compatibility_contracts.name: SceneNodeDirectionVectorContract
compatibility_contracts.description: SceneRelativeDirectionVectorCompute (0x0055D5C0) sets dirty flag 0x40000 at this+0x14, obtains a scene position from this+0xE8..0xF0 or via SceneNodePositionGetter (0x0054B950), and stores a twice-normalized delta direction at this+0x100/0x104/0x108. A replacement must preserve the three direction float offsets and the 0x40000 dirty flag.

compatibility_contracts.name: DirectXVectorStoreContract
compatibility_contracts.description: NormalizeAndStoreVectorWithDXUpdate (0x0055D460) writes a unit-normalized 3-float vector at this+0x44/0x48/0x4C, pushes it through DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup (0x005416A0, mode 5) using the handle at this+0x4 and global dword_8B78A0, and ORs dirty bit 0x800 into dword_8B8F28+236. A replacement must preserve the vector offsets, mode 5, and the 0x800 dirty bit.

compatibility_contracts.name: RecordArrayAddressingContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Network record array addressing: element index a2 resolves as base(offset 20) + a2 * stride(offset 8) through LinearInterpolation (0x5648B0); removal (0x564990) shifts the tail down by stride * (count - index - 1) bytes and decrements count at offset 0. A replacement must preserve the base/stride/count offsets and the address formula.
